rule=planning smoke passes only when footprint is passing and target keeps all expected-count guarded suites
rule=target-met smoke passes when current command footprint already equals the retained target
rule=unsafe-target smoke fails when the target declared step count is below expected-count guarded step count
rule=trend smoke passes when the retained target is met without losing expected-count guarded coverage
rule=regression smoke fails when retained command-footprint target coverage regresses
rule=fixture binds retained semantic values rather than brittle receipt hashes
